executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: The report, workflow and cross-project assessment independently interpret the same records; model claims and raw execution results are insufficiently distinguished.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Derive blocking conditions and the current responsible actor once, then consume them across reports and integration assessments.

model_stack: Claude Code with user-configured model; different-model reliability is not established

findings.title: Unresolved P0/P1 findings do not block acceptance or integration
findings.mechanism: Passing behavior records are sufficient even when review findings remain unresolved.
findings.root_cause: Workflow and feature snapshot logic omit review evidence gates.
findings.recommended_fix: Use current non-conflicting evidence for high-risk rechecks and propagate technical blockers to cross-project snapshots.

findings.title: Pending layout questions can displace the actual AI blocker
findings.mechanism: The renderer prioritizes the first decision independently of the backend current action.
findings.root_cause: Duplicated action and coverage derivation in JavaScript.
findings.recommended_fix: Consume a single derived primary action and effective stage.

findings.title: Model-authored test summaries resemble parsed execution results
findings.mechanism: A matching fingerprint and passed status do not establish execution or correct test counts.
findings.root_cause: No narrow execution and result-reparsing receipt path.
findings.recommended_fix: Execute explicit test argv, capture immutable run artifacts, parse supported formats and label provenance without claiming attestation.

findings.title: Recorded human observations are hidden on reload
findings.mechanism: Acceptance cards omit actual/reviewer/result and show only a fresh pending form.
findings.root_cause: Saved observations and new feedback drafts lack separate presentation.
findings.recommended_fix: Show recorded observations read-only with version and source, keeping new drafts separate.

findings.title: Environment prerequisites and duplicate checklists slow human review
findings.mechanism: Preparation is buried in summary text and legacy acceptance strings diverge from structured items.
findings.root_cause: No fixed preparation region and no authoritative structured checklist preference.
findings.recommended_fix: Use an optional typed preparation region and prefer existing structured acceptance items.

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: False readiness transfers unresolved technical risk to humans.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Capture and parse real test runs
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Model-written counts and revision rebinding were observed in live evaluation.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Claims and independently reparsed run results remain distinct.

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Preparation and previous observations are hard to find or absent.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: People can start the current check and compare new observations with historical records.
